title: LA Craft Outdoor – Celadon Sanggam · Misty Bamboo Forest
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her late 20s, black hair in a low braid with a jade pin, natural face with a serene smile.

Physique: Heavily oversized SuperBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — colossal soft belly hanging in deep rolling folds, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust, extremely wide hips, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms.

Body Art: Full body Goryeo celadon body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. High-gloss jade-green celadon glaze with fine crackle and soft uneven reflections, black-and-white sanggam cranes and chrysanthemums. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Standing on a stone path in a soft three-quarter front view, head tilted slightly, one hand resting on her belly, the other lightly touching a bamboo stalk. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Celadon-glazed platform stiletto sandals with ribbon laces wrapping up the calf and tied in a soft bow below the knee, fine crackle finish, 8-inch platform stilettos. Nails: celadon with white tips.

Background & Lighting: Misty Damyang bamboo forest, tall green stalks receding into fog, no other people. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame, low camera angle, 135mm lens. Soft overcast diffused light with gentle raking side light across the glaze, no harsh highlights. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
